notes:
Snapshot from calls and email threads - shorthand.
- Company: SaaS customer-service platform with embedded chat widget used by ~1,200 enterprise customers.
- Primary ask: Replace slow retrieval stack (Elastic + in-house reranker) with RAG that reduces agent handoffs and increases ticket deflection. Focus = embeddings + high-quality reranking for top-5 results.
- Scale: plan to index fast-moving KB + ticket history ~150M-300M documents (varied chunking); initial POC to validate 50M index baseline.
- Latency SLOs: VP Eng insists on <=150ms p95 end-to-end for a single RAG query (retrieve+embed+rerank). Reranker budget should add <=60ms p95. Tail latency sensitivity high (customer abandonment).
- Throughput target: sustained 200 qps per region during peak; spikes to 700 qps expected for special events. Must support autoscale and graceful throttling.
- Quality: product needs top-5 rerank precision (NDCG@5 / top-5 precision) improvement vs current baseline; target +12-18% relative improvement; manual eval sets available.
- Cost target: blended infra + model cost per query target <$0.05 at scale; acceptable tradeoffs if quality wins but need clear cost model.
- Model preferences: open models recommended but vendor-model flexibility required; plan to test 4-bit quantized variants.
- Security: strict SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration mandatory, data residency for EU customers (customer controls).
- Operational asks: per-route latency breakdown, token-level cost visibility, rerank explainability (why doc reordered), alerting for quality regressions.
- POC deliverables: benchmarking script, cost model, config template (batching, cache TTLs, retriever candidates), demo with live widget traffic replay.
- Quote from VP Eng: "Need sub-150ms tail — customers drop off otherwise."
- Decision factors: latency + costs at scale, security paperwork, proof that rerank improves top-5 quality reliably.
- Contacts: Head of ML = Priya Natarajan; VP Eng = Carlos Mendes.
- Internal red flags: procurement requires 3 vendor references; legal wants explicit data deletion SLA.
- AE notes: good fit for Redwood Dedicated + Optimize recommendations; Private considered for EU-resident customers.
